name: Gold Rain Enterprises Corp.
summary: Gold Rain Enterprises Corp., founded in 1969 and headquartered in Changhua, Taiwan, is dedicated to the development, manufacturing, and distribution of automated self-service machines. The company's diverse product portfolio, offered under the ALONA brand, includes various beverage, food, and specialized lifting vending machines, as well as smart devices. Beyond its standard offerings, Gold Rain also provides original equipment manufacturing (OEM) and original design manufacturing (ODM) services, with notable projects like OEM GoStation and IGT lottery machines, along with comprehensive sheet metal processing. Its operations span a wide international market, covering Taiwan, China, Japan, the United States, and several Southeast Asian countries.
